_docs.version: Config schema version (integer, default 1). Future pi-chafa versions may migrate on this.
_docs.preferNative: Delivery preference. true: native kitty/iTerm2 whenever supported. false: force Chafa symbols even on native terminals.
_docs.cellWidth: Chafa output width in columns (positive integer). Default 60; matches pi terminal.imageWidthCells.
_docs.maxRows: Absolute cap on symbols output rows — the chafa --size height bound (positive integer). Default 50.
_docs.symbolsSet: Chafa --symbols class list, e.g. block+border or ascii. Default block+border.
_docs.dither: Chafa --dither: none | ordered | diffusion | noise. Default none.
_docs.formatOrder: Reserved fallback-chain placeholder. v1 effective value is ["symbols"].
_docs.binaryPath: Optional explicit path to a chafa binary (overrides PATH discovery). null = discover on PATH.
_docs.timeoutMs: Wall-clock bound per chafa invocation in ms (positive integer). Default 8000.
